knowledge.text: The added Locate Phase Search section (coverage sweep, anti-cycle, exit-on-acquire) left behavior unchanged in current pairs whose required object was obtainable at the first plausible location visited: Parent and Candidate executed the same actions in the same number of steps, still taking the object immediately and completing the required transform-and-place. train:0010 (put a toiletpaper in toiletpaperhanger): both 8 steps, taking toiletpaper 1 from countertop 1 and moving it to toiletpaperhanger 1. train:0011 (put some toiletpaper on toiletpaperhanger): both 7 steps, taking toiletpaper 3 from drawer 2 and moving it to toiletpaperhanger 1. train:0012 (put a clean apple in diningtable): both 7 steps, taking apple 2 from fridge 1, cleaning it with sinkbasin 1, and moving it to diningtable 1. train:0018 (put a clean lettuce in fridge): both 7 steps, taking lettuce 1 from countertop 1, cleaning it with sinkbasin 1, and moving it to fridge 1. train:0019 (clean some plate and put it in fridge): both 7 steps, taking plate 1 from countertop 1, cleaning it with sinkbasin 1, and moving it to fridge 1. These runs show no disruption of acquisition, cleaning, or delivery, but they only lightly exercise the missing-target locate phase.
